proposed_fix.description: Temporarily increase CPU limits for currencyservice via a gated canary rollout to alleviate throttling, with explicit rollback if latency does not improve.
steps: Verify current CPU requests/limits and confirm disk I/O wait is not the primary bottleneck before proceeding.
Draft a manifest change to increase currencyservice CPU limits by 50% and submit for human approval.
Upon approval, apply the change to a 10% canary subset of pods.
Monitor currencyservice_latency-50 and currencyservice_cpu for 15 minutes; if latency drops and CPU stabilizes, promote to 100%, otherwise abort.
preconditions: Confirm current CPU limits and baseline usage metrics.
Verify disk I/O wait is low to ensure CPU scaling will address the root cause.
Ensure no conflicting maintenance windows or critical alerts are active.
proposed_fix.rollback: Revert CPU limits to original values and trigger a full deployment rollout to restore the previous configuration.
